title: Show ETA and remaining data before drive can be safely removed
line: While a drive is being removed, Disks & Devices now shows how much data is still being written to it and about how long that will take.
explanation: When safely removing a drive took more than a second, Disks & Devices only said "Don't unplug yet! Files are still being transferred…", with no idea of how much was left or how long to wait. The kernel's count of data still waiting to be written (Dirty + Writeback in /proc/meminfo) is the only source readable without root; per-device counters are only in debugfs. While a device is unmounting, the widget now samples that every second and shows the amount and, once it starts going down, an estimate of the time left from the observed write speed. Below 1 MiB, or when nothing is known, the old text stays.

commits.message:
applets/devicenotifier: show data left to write and time left when removing

When removing a device took longer than a second, the widget only said
files were still being transferred. While unmounting, it now reads how
much data is still waiting to be written and shows it with an estimate.

BUG: 519938

media.caption: Pure master, removing a stick with 900 MiB still to write: only "Files are still being transferred…".
With the change: "433.9 MiB still being transferred, about 10 seconds left…".
The whole removal on master: the text never changes for 20 seconds.
The whole removal with the change: amount and time left count down until the stick can be removed.
